summary: Late October 2026. Envydiel, Liberta and Palmer are rated S+ by every recent list, and Hybris, Sung Jinwoo, Daemia, Ivan and Rosaline are close behind. Patch v1.204 (Oct 6) added new Temporal Rift and Golden Frontier seasons and updated Nightmare Corridor, with no hero balance changes. 2026's new heroes (Valeri, Thalassa, Kyno, Athena, Medusa, and the Kaiju No. 8 pair Kafka Hibino and Kikoru Shinomiya) are still settling into their tiers.

metaShifts.text: v1.204 (Oct 6): new Temporal Rift and Golden Frontier seasons and a Nightmare Corridor update, with no hero balance changes. Pocket Gamer's list was refreshed Oct 2 for v1.203.01, AFK Global's on Oct 3 and Driffle's on Oct 16.
v1.200 (Aug 11): Thalassa – Abyssal Warden (S-tier support/healer). v1.201 (Aug 25): Valeri – Wilds Inventor (Mauler tank), rated A overall, strong in Campaign and Towers, weak in boss modes.

v1.198: Kyno – Scrapforge Prodigy (Draconis tank). AllClash rates Kyno S+ in Campaign, Dragonforge and Cursed Realm. One afk.guide snippet also lists Talimar – Hook of the Wastes as new. v1.199: Athena and Medusa (Dimensional). AllClash calls Athena's tank kit 'absolutely busted', and Medusa pairs with her.

v1.196 (Jun 16): Eluard – Catalyst of Fate (Awakened Lightbearer). v1.197 (Jun 30): Trix – Imp of Misrule (Hypogean). Eluard's skill text was reworded with no effect change, and Framton got a bug fix. These are the only 2026 'adjustments' found, so no real nerf or buff pass was identified.

v1.193: Misfortis – Fortune's Folly (Celestial INT tank). afk.guide calls Misfortis the strongest PvP Celestial, while ratings range from A to SS. v1.194: Severin – Scholar of Form (Draconis ranger). v1.195 (trial from May 28): Judy & Punch (Dimensional mage).

v1.191 (Apr 7): Serennia – Tidebound Devotion (Draconis ranger), plus adjustments to Saitama, Orthros and Melion (mostly bug fixes). v1.192 (Apr 21): Hybris (Hypogean) released and went straight to S+ on every 2026 list.

v1.189 (Mar 10): Harvey (Hypogean, later B-tier at afk.guide). v1.190 (~late Mar): Dracula – Sanguine Queen (Dimensional continuous-damage mage), used in afk.guide's Guild Trials level-999 teams. No grade found.
v1.187 (Feb 10): Icariel added. v1.188 (Feb 24): Odysseus added. No tier grades found for either yet.
Awakened Pippa released. AllClash: S overall, S+ in Campaign and Towers. A mid-priority Awakened that PvP players take early.

Approximate date (v1.163, estimated from the patch cadence): Envydiel – Venomous Desire (Awakened Hypogean) released. By 2026 every source rates Envydiel S+ and afk.guide calls Envydiel the strongest DPS in the game. Now the #1 Awakened priority (AllClash).

method: Every week Claude reads the newest community tier lists and guides, maps each source's grades onto one S+ to D scale (SS counts as S+), and keeps each source's raw grade so you can check the merge. A rating with fewer than two agreeing sources is marked as mixed or single-source. The AI analysis column is calculated, not crowd-sourced: the rules engine scores every hero from this week's ratings, game-data roles, synergies and each mode's needs, builds the best lineups from the full roster, and Claude reviews them and explains where they differ from the community.
gaps: Most community teams this week are cores of 1-3 named heroes, not full 5-hero lineups. Guide sites show lineups as images that could not be read. Partial lineups are labelled.
Formation positions were published only for the Twisted Realm teams. All other positions are inferred from hero class and role, and are labelled.
Kits were verified for 23 heroes. The rest use the game's own role tags (main and secondary role).
No current community team sets were found for Legends Championship, Cursed Realm, King's Tower or the faction towers.
PvP ratings are thin for many Lightbearer, Mauler and Wilder heroes. Where a category rating is missing, the overall rating is used.
Signature Item caps: patch 1.134 raised the cap to +50, but some 2025 guides still stop at +40. Check in game.
Seraphic Tide (Support artifact) has no effect text or rating yet.

Beast ratings come from one overall tier list (AFK Global, Oct 22 2026). PvE, PvP and boss grades only differ where a guide says a beast stands out in that mode, and beast picks per Nightmare Corridor comp could not be read.

113 heroes were missing from the tier lists as first read. 109 now have ratings from the full AFK Global (Oct 3, 2026) and Pocket Tactics (Apr 30, 2026) lists; the October list sets the tier and the April one only shows in the source notes. AFK Global's A+ counts as A. Kafka Hibino is A from the r/afkarena usage tier list's notes (its full list is an image not read yet). Awakened Theowyn, Kikoru Shinomiya and Oren are not rated by any list yet and count as B in team building.

ascension.heroRarityStart: Legendary-rarity and Ascended-rarity heroes (4F, Celestial, Hypogean, Dimensional, Draconis, Awakened) are summoned at Elite and can reach Ascended 5★. Lower-rarity heroes stop at lower tiers (exact caps not verified).

stars.notes: Stars exist only on Ascended heroes, from 1★ to 5★. Stars do not raise the level cap, which stays 240 plus the crystal. Ascended 1★ is required to unlock Eternal Engravings. No tier above Ascended 5★ was found up to patch 1.204.

ascension.visual: The portrait frame colour shows the tier: Rare is blue, Elite purple, Legendary gold/yellow, Mythic red/orange, Ascended white/silver with an ornate frame. Each '+' tier uses the same colour with an extra ornament or gem on the frame. Ascended stars appear as up to 5 small star icons under the portrait. This comes from general game knowledge and was not verified this session, so calibrate against real screenshots.

levels.lowerTierCaps: Caps for Common/Rare/Rare+ were not verified. One guide says Common-rarity heroes cap at 100.

crystal.notes: The Resonating Crystal sets the level of slotted heroes to the crystal's level, which is driven by your 5 highest-level heroes (the 'pentagram'). The 240 cap is lifted once 5 heroes reach 240, which needs 5 Ascended heroes. You then level the crystal directly. Its account cap is 240 + 5 for each Ascended hero you own. Dimensional heroes do not count, and stars do not matter. The Fandom wiki gives an absolute crystal maximum of 800, to be raised as new Ascended-tier heroes are added. Older guides give 455, 465 or 475, which probably reflect smaller rosters at the time. Only Ascended heroes can go above 240. Lower-tier heroes in crystal slots stay at their own tier cap. Past 240, levelling also costs Hero's Essence.

emblemBands.+0..+10: Primordial Emblems (220 total including the unlock)
emblemBands.+31..+40: Faction Emblems (820, or 1,050 in afk.guide's table) or 650 Epic Emblems

signatureItem.notes: Patch 1.134 (about 2023) raised the SI cap for 4F heroes from 30 to 50, and for Celestial/Hypogean/Dimensional/Awakened heroes from 40 to 50. A new skill effect unlocks at +40. Skill upgrades also come at +0, +10, +20 and +30 (standard milestones, not re-verified). Some 2025 guides still treat +40 as the top level, so confirm +50 in-game. The game shows the SI level as '+N' on the SI icon on the hero detail screen.

furniture.layout: 3 small, 3 medium and 3 large pieces per hero room in the Oak Inn
furniture.setBonuses: Hero-specific bonuses unlock at 3 Mythic pieces ('3f', also written 3/9) and at 9 Mythic pieces ('9f' or 9/9). Only Mythic-quality pieces count toward these bonuses.
furniture.unlock: A hero gets a room once it is Ascended. The Oak Inn furniture feature opens with your first Ascended hero.
furniture.notes: Furniture comes from Oak Inn pulls with Poe Coins, and Mythic furniture has a 30-pull pity. Record a mythic piece count of 0 to 9 for each hero. Furniture '+' upgrade levels beyond Mythic were not verified.

engraving.unlocks: The system opens after clearing campaign Chapter 21 (one guide says Chapter 23 for Elemental Cores). Each hero must be Ascended 1★ first. Lightbearers were added in patch 1.72. No source says higher stars raise the 100 cap.
engraving.structure: Each monolith has 3 Major Glyphs (20 levels each) and 5 Minor Glyphs (8 levels each), for 100 levels in total.
engraving.milestones: Levels 30 and 60 give skill upgrades. Level 80 unlocks a PvP-only ability ('Endeavor', per the wiki).
engraving.costBands: Levels 0-30 cost Elemental Shards. Levels 30-60, 60-80 and 80-100 cost Elemental Cores, at increasing rates.
engraving.notes: afk.guide's 1.180 update (Nov 2025) still describes the same structure. The game shows the engraving level as a number (0-100) on the engraving or monolith element on the hero detail screen (display not verified). Common community goals are E30, E60 and E80.

formation.factionAdvantage: Lightbearer > Mauler > Wilder > Graveborn > Lightbearer, with Celestial ⇄ Hypogean as mutual counters. The advantaged side gets +25% damage (some guides say 'up to 25%'). The wiki's Celestial and Hypogean pages contradict each other on direction, which fits a mutual advantage. No matchups were found for Dimensional or Draconis, which are probably neutral.
formation.factionBonus: Same-faction team bonus applied to all deployed heroes: 3 of one faction gives +10% ATK and +10% HP; 3+2 (two factions) gives +15% ATK and +15% HP; 4 of one faction gives +15% ATK and +20% HP; 5 of one faction gives +25% ATK and +25% HP. Draconis heroes add +2% ATK and +2% HP to all allies per Draconis hero deployed. Whether Celestial/Hypogean count as wildcards in AFK Arena is unverified; the wildcard rule found applies to AFK Journey.
formation.teamPower: Team Combat Rating (CR) is shown as the sum of the deployed heroes' individual CRs. Each hero's CR comes from its stats (level, gear, SI, furniture, engraving and so on). No exact formula was found.

screenshotHints.heroList: Not verified this session; based on general knowledge, so calibrate with real screenshots. Each hero tile is a square portrait. The frame colour or ornament shows the ascension tier (blue Rare, purple Elite, gold Legendary, red Mythic, white/silver Ascended, with an extra ornament for '+' tiers). A small faction icon sits in a top corner. The level number is printed on the tile. Ascended heroes show 1-5 star icons along the bottom edge. SI, furniture and engraving are generally not shown on the list tile.
screenshotHints.heroDetail: Not verified this session. The detail screen shows the hero model, name, faction and class icons, level (shown as the crystal level if slotted), ascension tier and stars, and Combat Rating. It also shows the 4 gear slots (tier shown on each item, plus enhancement stars) and the artifact or Collection slot with its stars. The Signature Item icon shows '+N' (0-50). The furniture or Oak Inn indicator shows mythic count out of 9, and the engraving icon shows the level (0-100), unlocked at Ascended 1★. Oath Mark status (2026) appears for 4F heroes. Exact placement needs checking against screenshots.
